annotations.text:
Renee Roy ad kit. Botanical wallpaper ground in the Better Homes and Gardens green (Pantone 363, #339933), with a white card on top so the message stays loud.
Her name, brokerage, office, phone and email are real. Everything in [BRACKETS] is a fill-in: listing details, dates, prices, the review, her licence number, the BHGRE logo, and photos.
The accent swatch above each artboard recolours the wallpaper, the badges and the call bars together.
Just Listed and Open House are meant to be reused. Duplicate the artboard for each property, swap the photo and the bracketed fields, and export.
